rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The President read the notice received that day from Prime Minister Abe (安倍内閣総理大臣): the cabinet had decided to resign en masse that day (Diet Law art. 64).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: First ballot in the House of Councillors: 240 votes, majority 121; 小沢一郎 117, 福田康夫 106, 志位和夫 7, 福島みずほ 5, 綿貫民輔 4, 1 blank; no majority, so a runoff between the top two.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the runoff (239 votes) 小沢一郎 received 133 and 福田康夫 106; the House of Councillors designated 小沢一郎.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Noting the House of Representatives' designation of 福田康夫, the President said the decisions differed and the House must request a joint committee under Diet Law art. 86(2); ten members were named after the recess.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: After the committee chair reported no agreement, the President declared that under Constitution art. 67(2) the House of Representatives' decision became the Diet's resolution; adjourned 17:10.

locator.speaker: 輿石東; 江田五月 (議長)
